rules.detection: Source event exists in selected capture.
limitations: Names only for raw messages; no causal association.

rules.detection: Pair rebuilt by nmf_decoder.pairs using identical non-null context_id.
rules.success: Pair outcome ok and terminal typed event HOS.
limitations: Nemo and HOI durations are separate; NR subtype is unknown without proof.

rules.detection: Exactly one connection indication in same context, strictly between boundaries; LTE system 7/8 or CAD call type 14 (VoLTE).
rules.success: Connection indication proves connected state, not normal release.
rules.end: Observed terminal event; no capture-end extension.
limitations: No NSA/SA/VoNR inference; ambiguous or missing indications omitted.

rules.detection: Task has seq_daa, directional task_type supplied by task parser.
rules.failure: Integrity partial is not automatically a failed transfer.
limitations: No task throughput mean fabricated; incomplete task is a marker.
